title: 15th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/15/3/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 8/3/2025 to 10/3/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of Law No. 20/2021 (Maldives Foreign Service Act), to appoint a Non-Resident Ambassador to Antigua and Barbuda is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
First reading of the resolution submitted by Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas calling for no permission to be given for catching sharks or shark fishing in the Maldives.
First reading of the Bill to repeal Law No. 1/2013 (Freedom of Peaceful Assembly Act), submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending Law No. 11/2022 (Evidence Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Bilehdhoo MP Ahmed Aslam.

Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the resolution submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to determine members' view on the government delaying flat handovers to many of the 4,000 beneficiaries of the Gedhoruveriya scheme, leaving reclamation at Gulhifalhu, Giraavarufalhu and Hulhumalé Phase 3 under the first Binveriya scheme unfinished, and ignoring the rights of applicants for Hulhumalé flats and Uthuru Thilafalhu land under the second Gedhoruveriya/Binveriya scheme while prioritising the Ras Malé project, costing thousands of Maldivians their right to housing.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to send an ambassador nomination to committee, introduce a shark-fishing resolution and a bill to repeal the Freedom of Peaceful Assembly Act, open debate on the Evidence Act amendment, and continue the housing resolution debate.
